answer: Make trust thaw like a glacier, not arrive overnight: a newcomer joins a small surety ring of unrelated veterans who each stake a little timber-backed credit on its honesty, and the ring's pooled stake is forfeited if any member proves a duplicate. The newcomer must then complete useful work across harsh, unrelated domains, from frozen tundra logistics to slow glacier survey routes, with each job checked by a different outsider. Fake identities need fresh rings, fresh stakes and real work in every climate, so mass-producing clones costs more than honest participation pays.
